trial_court: Family Court, Alwar (for short 'the Family Court')
case_name: Kunal Bagarhatta S/O Shri Om Prakash vs Smt Shipra Sharma (Bagarhatta) W/O ...
facts_of_case: The respondent-wife filed petition for divorce under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955. The parties were relegated to mediation where efforts were made for amicable settlement between them, but failed. Subsequently, they agreed to obtain a decree of divorce by mutual consent on permanent alimony.

legal_principles.principle: Parties can agree to withdraw pending cases.
legal_principles.held: Both the parties agreed to have a decree of divorce and further that a permanent alimony be paid to the parties of Part-II by the party of Part-I to the tune of Ra. 40.00 lacs as full and final settlement.

legal_principles.principle: Parties can agree to settle disputes through compromise.
legal_principles.held: Conciliation and negotiation taken place at various stages including at the stage of pending appeal before the Hon'ble High Court, both the parties agreed to have a decree of divorce and further that a permanent alimony be paid to the parties of Part-II by the party of Part-I to the tune of Ra. 40.00 lacs as full and final settlement.

outcome.final_order: The appellant has been directed to pay to the respondent-wife a sum of Rs. 40,00,000/- as permanent alimony.
